Village Idiots Wednesday Night Worlds

Lakewood Ranch, FL · Road

Village Idiots Wednesday Night Worlds is a road group ride in Lakewood Ranch, FL. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Village Bikes Lakewood Ranch. About 30 miles, a 26+ down to D 14–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Village Idiots Wednesday Night Worlds group ride

Sarasota-Bradenton's Wednesday evening ride. Seven groups from a 26-plus hammerfest down to a 14–16 mph no-drop group, so there is a spot for most people. Thirty miles, then the pub on Main Street.
